env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^n1$'
stdout '^m1$'
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exec grep '_logos_unsafe "unsafe"' out/main.go
! exec grep -rn '_logos_strconv' out
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cd out
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectinterplambda

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func conv(g func(int) string) string { return g(1) }

func main() {
	fmt.Println(conv(x => $"n{x}"))
	fmt.Println(conv(x => { return $"m{x}" }))
}
